title: S8E2 毕业后，我们与社会的距离
title_en: S8E2 After Graduation: The Distance Between Us and Society
summary_cn: 毕业季特别节目：希希、小焦、老袁三位「资深毕业人士」从各自毕业记忆出发，借听友来信讨论激情破灭、社会化打分与毕业法则，追问毕业后如何与社会的距离自处
summary_en: A graduation-season special: Xixi, Xiao Jiao, and Lao Yuan, three veteran graduates, start from their own graduation memories, work through listener letters, and talk about crushed passion, the grading game of socialization, and their rules for life after school — asking how to live with the distance between yourself and society once you graduate.

scenes.title_cn: 一、毕业记忆：仓促与庆祝并存
scenes.title_en: Graduation Memories: Haste and Celebration Side by Side
scenes.context: 三位主播各自讲述毕业当天的仓促与情绪：疫情领证、答辩悬空、喝酒到凌晨。语域：casual 播客闲聊 + 回忆分享。
scenes.speak: The starting point: graduation is never a single emotion — it's a mix of relief, loneliness, confusion, or happiness. Xixi graduated from her master's during the pandemic, picking up her diploma at the school gate like exchanging intelligence, then spotting a stunning sunset on Beijing's empty streets and laughing out loud in the car — finally, no more studying! Xiao Jiao's PhD defense advisor vanished before the defense, the committee had to be reassembled at the last minute, and she graduated in a state of total suspension. Lao Yuan graduated from undergrad in a plaid skirt, drinking with friends until six in the morning, excitement and confusion side by side. So when your graduation feels not perfect enough, remember that haste and uncertainty are the norm for most people — a composed graduation is the lucky minority. One foot has already stepped forward, but the last step's problems are still unsolved. It contrasts with a listener letter saying 'graduated and unemployed, but oddly calm' — there is no standard answer to how you should feel.

sentences.cn: 核心机制：毕业从来不是单一情绪——可以是解脱、孤独、迷茫或幸福的混合体
sentences.en: The starting point: graduation is never a single emotion — it's a mix of relief, loneliness, confusion, or happiness.
sentences.note: 表达提示a single emotion → 单一情绪；a mix of → 混合体

sentences.cn: 关键理解：希希硕士毕业时赶上疫情，校门口像交换情报一样领取毕业证，空荡北京路上看到绝美夕阳，在车里放声大笑「终于不用再读书了」。小焦博士答辩前导师失踪，最后一刻重组答辩委员会，在完全悬空感中毕业。老袁本科毕业穿格子裙与好友喝酒到凌晨六点，兴奋与迷茫并存
sentences.en: The key insight: Xixi graduated from her master's during the pandemic, picking up her diploma at the school gate like exchanging intelligence, then spotting a stunning sunset on Beijing's empty streets and laughing out loud in the car — 'finally, no more studying!' Xiao Jiao's PhD defense advisor vanished before the defense, the committee had to be reassembled at the last minute, and she graduated in a state of total suspension. Lao Yuan graduated from undergrad in a plaid skirt, drinking with friends until six in the morning, excitement and confusion side by side.
sentences.note: 表达提示like exchanging intelligence → 像交换情报；total suspension → 完全悬空感；side by side → 并存

sentences.cn: 典型场景：当你觉得毕业「不够圆满」时，仓促和不确定其实是很多人的常态，从容毕业是幸运的少数
sentences.en: How to use it: when your graduation feels 'not perfect enough,' remember that haste and uncertainty are the norm for most people — a composed graduation is the lucky minority.
sentences.note: 表达提示not perfect enough → 不够圆满；the norm → 常态；the lucky minority → 幸运的少数

sentences.cn: （引用）原文依据：「下一步脚已经迈出去了，上一步还没有解决问题呢」「我是谁，我在哪，我为什么会在这种完全悬空的感觉中毕业了」
sentences.en: 'One foot has already stepped forward, but the last step's problems are still unsolved.' And: 'Who am I, where am I, and why am I graduating in this completely suspended feeling?'
sentences.note: 表达提示step forward → 迈出去；completely suspended → 完全悬空

sentences.cn: （引用）相关概念：与听友信中「毕业及失业但心却平静」形成对照，情绪没有标准答案
sentences.en: Related idea: it contrasts with a listener letter saying 'graduated and unemployed, but oddly calm' — there is no standard answer to how you should feel.
sentences.note: 表达提示contrast with → 形成对照；oddly calm → 意外平静；standard answer → 标准答案

sentences.cn: 希希提到给大一生上课时，学生就问如何规划职业，而她三十几岁也不知道。对比十年前大学生对职业发展课「嗤之以鼻」，现在焦虑明显提前
sentences.en: Xixi mentions teaching freshmen who already ask how to plan a career — and she, in her thirties, still doesn't know. Ten years ago students sneered at career-development classes; now the anxiety has clearly moved earlier.
sentences.note: 表达提示sneer at → 嗤之以鼻；the anxiety has moved earlier → 焦虑明显提前；freshmen → 大一新生

phrases: Graduation is a cocktail of emotions, not one feeling.
It's relief, loneliness, and confusion all at once.
paraphrase.chunks: a cocktail of emotions · all at once
paraphrase.usage: a cocktail of 是很形象的口语说法

paraphrase.intent: 想说「多数人毕业都很仓促」
phrases: A picture-perfect graduation is the exception, not the rule.
Most graduations are messy and rushed — and that's normal.
paraphrase.chunks: picture-perfect · the exception, not the rule · rushed
paraphrase.usage: the exception, not the rule 是常用短语

scenes.title_cn: 二、激情与热爱：奢侈品还是风向标？
scenes.title_en: Passion and Love: A Luxury or a Compass?
scenes.context: 听友因无法对劳动产生激情而纠结是否转行，主播们讨论「追求激情」是不是奢侈品。语域：casual 播客点评 + 自我剖析。
scenes.speak: The setup: she chose her path by passion, got into the best school in the field, then found in an internship that she couldn't feel passion for the work itself — but switching fields means starting from zero. The key insight: this confusion means you're still searching — your standards haven't blurred, and that's actually a good thing. Chasing passion is itself a luxury; many people face the numbness of 'A is fine, B is also fine.' So when you're already in an ideal position, you don't have to switch immediately — explore other possibilities while doing what you do now. As the hosts say, having this confusion is actually a good thing, because it means you're still searching. Xixi pursues excellence and keeps looking for a place where she can fully realize her potential. Lao Yuan's standard is simpler: passion equals physical and mental health plus not being exhausted — because of his migraines, when he overdoes it, he collapses, so he refuses to burn himself out.

sentences.cn: 核心机制：按激情选了路，进入专业最好院校，实习后发现无法对劳动产生激情，改行又怕从零开始
sentences.en: The setup: she chose her path by passion, got into the best school in the field, then found in an internship that she couldn't feel passion for the work itself — but switching fields means starting from zero.
sentences.note: 表达提示by passion → 按激情选；start from zero → 从零开始

sentences.cn: 关键理解：这种困惑说明你还在寻找，标准没有被模糊，其实是好事。追求激情本身是奢侈品，很多人面对的是「做A也可以做B也可以」的麻木
sentences.en: The key insight: this confusion means you're still searching — your standards haven't blurred, and that's actually a good thing. Chasing passion is itself a luxury; many people face the numbness of 'A is fine, B is also fine.'
sentences.note: 表达提示still searching → 还在寻找；blur one's standards → 模糊标准；the numbness of … → …的麻木感

sentences.cn: 典型场景：已在理想位置时，不必立刻转行，可在做当前事的同时探索别的可能
sentences.en: How to use it: when you're already in an ideal position, you don't have to switch immediately — explore other possibilities while doing what you do now.
sentences.note: 表达提示switch immediately → 立刻转行；explore other possibilities → 探索别的可能

sentences.cn: （引用）原文依据：「我无法对这种劳动产生激情」「我觉得有这种困惑其实是一件好事，因为在这里说，你还在寻找」
sentences.en: 'I can't feel passion for this kind of work.' And: 'I think having this confusion is actually a good thing, because it means you're still searching.'
sentences.note: 表达提示feel passion for → 对…产生激情；still searching → 还在寻找

sentences.cn: 希希：追求卓越，寻找能百分百发挥潜能的地方，持续在寻找中
sentences.en: Xixi: she pursues excellence, looks for a place where she can fully realize her potential, and keeps searching.
sentences.note: 表达提示pursue excellence → 追求卓越；realize one's potential → 发挥潜能

sentences.cn: 老袁：激情=身心健康+不累着。因偏头痛，累着了就倒下，所以标准是不能把自己累坏
sentences.en: Lao Yuan: for him, passion equals physical and mental health plus not being exhausted. Because of his migraines, when he overdoes it he collapses, so his standard is simply not burning himself out.
sentences.note: 表达提示burn oneself out → 把自己累坏；physical and mental health → 身心健康；overdo it → 过度劳累

paraphrase.intent: 想说「找不到激情不代表你错了」
phrases: Not feeling passion doesn't mean you're failing.
Struggling with passion just means you're still searching.
paraphrase.usage: 第二句直接把困惑重定义为好事，适合安慰人

paraphrase.intent: 想说「没什么特别想做的事」
phrases: Nothing really excites me — A is fine, B is fine too.
I've gone numb to choosing between options.
paraphrase.chunks: nothing excites me · gone numb · A is fine, B is fine
paraphrase.usage: gone numb 表达「麻木」，很地道

scenes.title_cn: 三、社会化：打分游戏与学术底色
scenes.title_en: Socialization: The Grading Game and Its Academic Roots
scenes.context: 用倒扣酒杯的尴尬回忆引出社会化的定义：它是社会再生产机制，而非夸奖。语域：formal 学术概念 + casual 回忆反差。
scenes.speak: In film school, Lao Yuan learned from crew dinners that turning the cup upside down after drinking means sincerity. When he did it in front of his master's advisor and classmates, the whole room went pupils quaking — social skills have completely different applicability in different settings. As he jokes, if someone says you're very social, that's definitely an insult. The concept: in Parsons' structural functionalism, socialization is a mechanism of social reproduction — like a cultural download of learning how adults are supposed to behave. The key insight: who decides the norms? Marginalized groups don't have this grammar. The same behavior can be absurd in a different cultural setting — the flipped cup, the rules about the seat of honor. And the boundary: in academia, socialization is not a compliment; carrying on bad culture, the drinking-table rituals, the ranked seating, is not the same as maturity. As the hosts ask, by learning all this, aren't we really just perpetuating some pretty bad culture?

sentences.cn: 电影学院跟剧组吃饭，老袁学到喝完酒倒扣杯子表示真诚。碩士时对着导师和同学这样做，全场「瞳孔地震」——社会化技能在不同场合适用性完全不同
sentences.en: In film school, Lao Yuan learned from crew dinners that turning the cup upside down after drinking means sincerity. When he did it in front of his master's advisor and classmates, the whole room went 'pupils quaking' — social skills have completely different applicability in different settings.
sentences.note: 表达提示pupils quaking → 瞳孔地震（保留中文梗的画面感）；applicability → 适用性；crew dinner → 剧组饭局

sentences.cn: （引用）「如果他说你很社会，那这句话肯定是骂人的」
sentences.en: 'If someone says you're very 'social,' that's definitely an insult.'
sentences.note: 表达提示中文「你很社会」是贬义；英文用引号 + 后接解释避免误解。

sentences.cn: 核心机制：Parsons 结构功能主义中，社会化是社会再生产机制，像「文化下载」——学习大人该怎么做
sentences.en: The concept: in Parsons' structural functionalism, socialization is a mechanism of social reproduction — like a 'cultural download' of learning how adults are supposed to behave.
sentences.note: 表达提示structural functionalism → 结构功能主义；social reproduction → 社会再生产；cultural download → 文化下载

sentences.cn: 关键理解：规范由谁决定？边缘群体没有这套语法。同一行为在不同文化环境可能离谱（倒扣酒杯、主座规矩）
sentences.en: The key insight: who decides the norms? Marginalized groups don't have this grammar. The same behavior can be absurd in a different cultural setting — the flipped cup, the rules about the seat of honor.
sentences.note: 表达提示marginalized groups → 边缘群体；seat of honor → 主座；absurd → 离谱

sentences.cn: 适用边界：学术里社会化不是褒义词；延续糟糕文化（酒桌、等级座位）不等于成熟
sentences.en: Boundary: in academia, socialization is not a compliment; carrying on bad culture — the drinking-table rituals, the ranked seating — is not the same as maturity.
sentences.note: 表达提示not a compliment → 不是褒义词；ranked seating → 等级座位；carry on → 延续

sentences.cn: （引用）原文依据：「学这些东西真的不是在延续一些糟糕的文化吗」
sentences.en: 'By learning all this, aren't we really just perpetuating some pretty bad culture?'
sentences.note: 表达提示perpetuate → 延续（带负面含义）；pretty bad culture → 糟糕的文化

paraphrase.intent: 想说「这套社交语法只在小圈子里有效」
phrases: That social grammar only works inside a certain circle.
The same move that's golden at a crew dinner is absurd at a defense.
paraphrase.chunks: social grammar · only works inside · golden … absurd
paraphrase.usage: 第二句用对比举例，很有画面感

paraphrase.intent: 想说「学这些不等于成熟」
phrases: Mastering the rituals isn't the same as growing up.
Following bad culture isn't maturity — it's just conformity.
paraphrase.chunks: master the rituals · isn't the same as · conformity
paraphrase.usage: conformity 是正式用词，适合总结观点

scenes.title_en: Moving Forward and Separating Feelings from Action
scenes.context: 希希提出「做了什么就想方设法去爱」，老袁讨论「往前看的人是普通人」以及把社交当工作完成的剥离法。语域：casual 播客点评 + 人生方法。
scenes.speak: Xixi proposes a way to open up life: instead of do what you love, it's whatever you've chosen to do, find a way to love it. Just as the body needs moderate discomfort to grow, so does the mind. In practice, for introverts, treat necessary socializing as a job to get done — don't pour too much feeling into it, and lower the psychological threshold. Meanwhile, a friend told Lao Yuan on a walk, 'you still need to look forward and do new things' — it shook him, because he and many of his friends never look forward; they stay parked at a certain stage. But he also notes that artists need to stay somewhere and keep digging deeper — it's ordinary people who look forward. As he puts it, people who look forward are ordinary people; artists are people who stay in one place — and he's not an artist. There's also the move of replacing 'do I want to?' with 'should I do it?' When a project-manager role demanded socializing, she treated it as work, separating feelings from action — and it went well, with positive feedback.

sentences.cn: 希希提出打开人生的方法：不是「爱什么做什么」，而是「做了什么就想方设法去爱」。身体也需要承受适度不适才能成长，心理上亦然
sentences.en: Xixi proposes a way to open up life: instead of 'do what you love,' it's 'whatever you've chosen to do, find a way to love it.' Just as the body needs moderate discomfort to grow, so does the mind.
sentences.note: 表达提示find a way to love it → 想方设法去爱；moderate discomfort → 适度不适；so does the mind → 心理上亦然

sentences.cn: （引用）「不是我爱什么去做什么，而是我做了什么就想方设法去爱这件事」
sentences.en: 'It's not about doing what I love — it's about finding a way to love whatever I've chosen to do.'
sentences.note: 表达提示本期金句；It's not about A, it's about B 是强调对比的句式。

sentences.cn: （引用）怎么落地：对内向者，把必要社交当「工作」完成，不投入过多情感，降低心理门槛
sentences.en: In practice: for introverts, treat necessary socializing as a 'job' to get done — don't pour too much feeling into it, and lower the psychological threshold.
sentences.note: 表达提示psychological threshold → 心理门槛；pour feeling into → 投入情感；treat A as B → 把A当B

sentences.cn: 老袁散步时朋友说「你还是要往前看，要做新的事情」——大为震撼，因为自己和很多朋友都不会往前看，停留在某阶段。但他也提出：艺术家需要停留在某处反复深挖，往前看的是普通人
sentences.en: While on a walk, a friend told Lao Yuan, 'you still need to look forward and do new things' — it shook him, because he and many of his friends never look forward; they stay parked at a certain stage. But he also notes: artists need to stay somewhere and keep digging deeper — it's ordinary people who look forward.
sentences.note: 表达提示look forward → 往前看；stay parked at a stage → 停留在某阶段；keep digging deeper → 反复深挖

sentences.cn: （引用）「往前看的人是普通人，艺术家是要停留在某处的人。I'm not an artist.」
sentences.en: 'People who look forward are ordinary people; artists are people who stay in one place. I'm not an artist.'
sentences.note: 表达提示stay in one place → 停留在某处；ordinary people → 普通人

sentences.cn: 用「应不应该做」替代「想不想做」。做项目经理需要社交时，当成工作干，情感与行为分离，反而做得不错并获得正反馈。社会化也许是把激情（情感）与事（行为）剥离的步骤
sentences.en: Replace 'do I want to?' with 'should I do it?' When a project-manager role demanded socializing, she treated it as work, separating feelings from action — and it went well, with positive feedback. Socialization may be exactly the step that separates passion, the feeling, from the task, the behavior.
sentences.note: 表达提示separate feelings from action → 情感与行为分离；positive feedback → 正反馈；replace A with B → 用B替代A

paraphrase.intent: 想说「别问想不想，问该不该」
phrases: Stop asking if you want to — ask if you should.
Judge by responsibility, not by mood.
paraphrase.chunks: ask if you should · judge by responsibility
paraphrase.usage: 第一句直接可复用，口语很顺

phrases: Treat socializing like a task on your to-do list.
See it as work — do it well without overinvesting emotion.
paraphrase.chunks: a task on your to-do list · overinvest emotion
paraphrase.usage: overinvest emotion 对应「投入过多情感」

scenes.title_en: Three Rules for Life After Graduation
scenes.context: 三条法则：优点要成对出现、快乐是底线校准、去更大的世界发现更多规则。语域：formal 播客总结 + 人生建议。
scenes.speak: Why it matters: Lao Yuan once suffered endless meaningless pain in screenwriting for the sake of perseverance — until he broke down with no warning at all. Virtues must come in pairs: perseverance with joy or health, kindness with boundaries, courage with wisdom, endurance with self-love. The boundary: even when short-term pain buys a long-term right direction, joy still has to stay as your baseline calibration. So in practice, whenever you try to convince yourself with 'just persevere,' ask: does this make me happy? Is it healthy for me? Xiao Jiao adds a second rule: going to a bigger world when you're young — big cities, different industries — reveals that society runs on many rule sets, so you're never forced into a closed little society's binary choice of join or don't join. And it doesn't have to mean going abroad; the path from a small city to a provincial capital to a big city counts too.

sentences.cn: 为什么重要：老袁曾因「坚持」在写剧本上吃了很多毫无意义的苦，直到毫无症状崩溃。优点必须成对出现：坚持+快乐/健康，善良+边界，勇敢+智慧，忍耐+自爱
sentences.en: Why it matters: Lao Yuan once suffered endless meaningless pain in screenwriting for the sake of 'perseverance' — until he broke down with no warning at all. Virtues must come in pairs: perseverance with joy or health, kindness with boundaries, courage with wisdom, endurance with self-love.
sentences.note: 表达提示virtues must come in pairs → 优点必须成对出现；for the sake of → 为了；break down → 崩溃

sentences.cn: 适用边界：短期痛苦换长期正确方向时，仍需快乐作为底线校准
sentences.en: Boundary: even when short-term pain buys a long-term right direction, joy still has to stay as your baseline calibration.
sentences.note: 表达提示baseline calibration → 底线校准；short-term pain buys → 短期痛苦换来

sentences.cn: （引用）「坚持是一个很好的词，但这个世界上的优点必须要成对的出现」
sentences.en: 'Perseverance is a wonderful word, but every virtue in this world has to come in pairs.'
sentences.note: 表达提示come in pairs → 成对出现；wonderful word → 很好的词

sentences.cn: （引用）怎么落地：每次想用「坚持」说服自己时，问：这件事让我快乐吗？身心健康吗？
sentences.en: In practice: whenever you try to convince yourself with 'just persevere,' ask: does this make me happy? Is it healthy for me?
sentences.note: 表达提示convince yourself → 说服自己；make me happy → 让我快乐

sentences.cn: 为什么重要：小焦相信年轻时去更大世界（大城市、不同行业），能发现社会有多种规则，不必在封闭小社会里二选一「加入还是不加入」
sentences.en: Why it matters: Xiao Jiao believes that going to a bigger world when you're young — big cities, different industries — reveals that society runs on many rule sets, so you're never forced into a closed little society's binary choice of 'join or don't join.'
sentences.note: 表达提示rule sets → 规则体系；binary choice → 二选一；a bigger world → 更大的世界

sentences.cn: 适用边界：不必出国才算；小城市→省会→大城市也是路径
sentences.en: Boundary: it doesn't have to mean going abroad; the path from a small city to a provincial capital to a big city counts too.
sentences.note: 表达提示provincial capital → 省会；counts too → 也算一种路径

paraphrase.intent: 想说「坚持本身是中性的，要配上快乐」
phrases: Perseverance is only a virtue when it comes with joy.
Pure grit without happiness is just self-punishment.
paraphrase.chunks: only a virtue when · pure grit · self-punishment
paraphrase.usage: grit 是「坚持/韧劲」的流行词；self-punishment 很锋利

paraphrase.intent: 想说「去更大的地方才能看到更多活法」
phrases: The bigger the world you see, the more ways of living you learn.
Moving outward shows you that many rule sets exist.
paraphrase.chunks: ways of living · rule sets · moving outward
paraphrase.usage: rule sets 呼应原文术语，正式场合可用

scenes.context: 三位听友来信的精选片段：跨考后平静、距离不是问题、还有没变成做题机器的人。语域：casual 来信朗读 + 播客点评。
scenes.speak: First letter: terrified during the cross-major exam, but oddly calm when graduation actually came. Graduation is just a temporary break from schooling — she's still pursuing an intellectual life and won't stop. Second letter: no time to be sad at graduation — distance, he believes, is not a problem. Friends with similar ways of thinking, even in different industries, still have endless common language when they meet. Third letter: she hasn't turned into a utilitarian test-taking machine — she still keeps a diary, reads, and listens to music. And since the show was recorded during the college entrance exams, here's a wish for clear skies and getting into your dream school.

sentences.cn: 跨考阶段恐惧，真正毕业时反而平静。毕业只是求学暂时割席，仍在追求智识生活，不会停步
sentences.en: Terrified during the cross-major exam, but oddly calm when graduation actually came. Graduation is just a temporary break from schooling — she's still pursuing an intellectual life and won't stop.
sentences.note: 表达提示cross-major exam → 跨考；a temporary break → 暂时割席；intellectual life → 智识生活

sentences.cn: 毕业时没时间难过，相信距离不是问题。相似思维方式的朋友即使不同行业，相聚仍有无尽共同语言
sentences.en: No time to be sad at graduation — distance, he believes, is not a problem. Friends with similar ways of thinking, even in different industries, still have endless common language when they meet.
sentences.note: 表达提示common language → 共同语言；no time to be sad → 没时间难过

sentences.cn: 没变成功利做题机器，仍写日记、阅读、听歌。录节目时正值高考，祝愿天气晴朗、上岸梦校
sentences.en: She hasn't turned into a utilitarian test-taking machine — she still keeps a diary, reads, and listens to music. The show was recorded during the college entrance exams, so here's a wish for clear skies and getting into your dream school.
sentences.note: 表达提示test-taking machine → 做题机器；dream school → 梦校；college entrance exams → 高考

paraphrase.intent: 想说「焦虑都集中在备考阶段」
phrases: The fear peaks during the exam prep, not the finish line.
She was most anxious before graduation, not at it.
paraphrase.chunks: the fear peaks · during the prep · not at the finish line
paraphrase.usage: 第二句把对比说得很清楚

paraphrase.intent: 想说「真正懂你的朋友不在乎行业」
phrases: Industry doesn't matter when your minds think alike.
Different careers, same wavelength — that's what counts.
paraphrase.chunks: think alike · same wavelength · what counts
paraphrase.usage: same wavelength 形容「同频」，很口语

practice.cn: 用「side by side」说：兴奋与迷茫并存。
practice.en: Excitement and confusion walked side by side through her whole graduation summer.

practice.cn: 用「find a way to love it」说：做了什么就想方设法去爱。
practice.en: Whatever you've chosen to do, find a way to love it.

practice.cn: 用「virtues must come in pairs」说：优点必须成对出现。
practice.en: Virtues must come in pairs — perseverance without joy is just self-punishment.

practice.cn: 用「binary choice」说：你不必在加入还是不加入之间二选一。
practice.en: You're never forced into the binary choice of join or don't join.

pitfalls.right: In that circle, calling someone 'very social' is definitely an insult.
pitfalls.why: 中文「你很社会」是贬义，直译 social 会让人误以为是褒义，需要加语境解释。

pitfalls.right: A composed, picture-perfect graduation is the lucky minority — haste is the norm.
pitfalls.why: 「不够圆满」不是客观缺点而是普遍常态；用 the lucky minority / the norm 才准确。

pitfalls.wrong: Socialization means knowing how to drink and toast.
pitfalls.right: Socialization is a mechanism of social reproduction — learning the adult grammar of a culture.
pitfalls.why: 「社会化」是学术概念不是酒桌技巧；用 mechanism of social reproduction 才对应播客的学术讨论。

pitfalls.wrong: I don't want to do this work, so I should quit.
pitfalls.right: It's not about doing what I love — it's about finding a way to love what I do.
pitfalls.why: 直接下结论「该辞职」丢掉了本期方法；用 It's not about A, it's about B 的句式复述观点。

shifts.before: 以为毕业必须是圆满的、告别必须是隆重的
shifts.after: 仓促与悬空才是多数人的常态，情绪没有标准答案

shifts.before: 以为「坚持」是越多越好的品质
shifts.after: 优点必须成对出现，快乐与健康是底线校准

shifts.before: 以为没有激情就该立刻转行
shifts.after: 有困惑说明你还在寻找；更重要的是「做了什么就想方设法去爱」
